title: The Female of the Species
author: Mindy McGinnis
current_text: Clay County School District in Florida banned The Female of the Species pending investigation during AY 2022-2023 following a formal challenge. Beaufort County School District in South Carolina banned The Female of the Species pending investigation in October 2022 following an informal challenge.
